definitions.explanation: A seat suspended by ropes or chains from a frame, used for swinging back and forth.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}でぶらんこに{乗|の}った。
examples.english: I rode on the swing in the park.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}がぶらんこを{漕|こ}いでいる。
examples.english: The child is swinging on the swing.

examples.japanese: ぶらんこから{飛|と}び{降|お}りないで。

notes:
ぶらんこ is a playground swing.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ぶらんこに{乗|の}る (get on a swing)
- ぶらんこを{漕|こ}ぐ (swing on a swing)
- ぶらんこから{降|お}りる (get off a swing)
- ぶらんこを{押|お}す (push a swing)

ETYMOLOGY:
The word is believed to come from the onomatopoeia ぶらぶら (swinging/dangling motion) + こ (child-friendly suffix).

RELATED PLAYGROUND EQUIPMENT:
- {滑|すべ}り{台|だい} (slide)
